summary: First end-to-end QA pass for ReelLab Studio MVP. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests pass covering auth, clients, projects, AI editor flow, invoices, community + stars, help bot, and CEO endpoints. Frontend: critical flows verified — Register → Legal Gate → Dashboard works, CEO login redirects to /ceo and Back Office renders with live data (users, projects, invoices, posts counters). Onboarding tour appears for new users. All Stripe/AI integrations confirmed mocked and complete instantly. Two minor frontend issues observed (see below).

ui_bugs.issue: Tour overlay (after first registration on /dashboard) intercepts clicks on background nav links (e.g. AI Editor) and the theme-toggle button. User must Skip/finish the tour before those controls become reliably clickable. Suggest making the tour pointer-events:none on the dimming layer or auto-dismiss when nav is clicked.

issues: Legal Gate 'Continue' button and the 3 acceptance checkboxes have no data-testid (spec claims all interactive elements do). Tests had to fall back to text matching.
OnboardingTour Skip/Next buttons also lack data-testid attributes.

action_items: Add data-testid to LegalGate checkboxes (e.g. legal-cb-terms, legal-cb-conduct, legal-cb-tos) and Continue button (legal-accept).
Add data-testid to OnboardingTour controls (tour-skip, tour-next, tour-prev).

Ensure OnboardingTour overlay does not block top-nav/theme-toggle clicks, OR auto-dismiss when user navigates away. Right now overlay swallows pointer events for header buttons on first dashboard visit.
(Nice-to-have) consistent testid suffix — login uses 'login-email' but register also uses 'register-email' (good); these match. No change required.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth uses JWT Bearer with HS256 and 7-day expiry stored in localStorage as 'rl_token' (per spec). No httpOnly cookie option — acceptable for MVP scope, but worth flagging for production hardening (XSS exposure).
CEO seeded on startup with password 'ReelLabceo26!' hardcoded; consider env var for production deployment.
All money/total computations on backend (invoice total = sum(items.amount)) — verified correct.
Community star endpoint correctly enforces 1/day/recipient limit and blocks self-stars (tested).
Help bot keyword matcher returns sensible fallback for no-match (verified).

success_rate.frontend: ~85% — all primary user flows pass; onboarding overlay blocks 2 secondary controls

test_credentials: CEO: ceo@reellabstudio.com / ReelLabceo26! (verified). Test studio users are registered dynamically with TEST_*@example.com prefix.
seed_data_creation: Each pytest run registers one fresh studio user (TEST_studio_<hex>@example.com) and creates TEST_-prefixed clients, projects, invoices, community posts that remain in DB (no cleanup endpoint exposed). CEO is pre-seeded by backend startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Note pydantic EmailStr rejects '.test' TLD; use '@example.com'. Frontend testids: login-{email,password,submit}, register-{display-name,username,email,password,submit}, nav-{dashboard,projects,clients,ai-editor,invoices,community}, nav-ceo, theme-toggle, user-menu-btn, menu-logout. Legal Gate + OnboardingTour controls lack testids — flagged as action item. AI Editor route is /editor (not /ai-editor). Test reports XML at /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml.
rca_of_the_issue: OnboardingTour overlay click-interception RCA: on a brand-new user the tour mounts on Dashboard with a full-screen translucent backdrop. The backdrop element captures pointer events for the area outside the modal card, blocking the underlying nav links and theme-toggle until tour is dismissed. Reproduction: register a fresh user, accept legal, land on /dashboard, click 'AI Editor' nav link — URL stays at /dashboard. Mitigation: either set pointer-events:none on the backdrop, attach a click handler that auto-dismisses, or render the tour after the nav z-index.
